mechanism: Venlafaxine inhibits norepinephrine reuptake while methylphenidate increases norepinephrine release, creating additive sympathomimetic effects; methylphenidate may also inhibit CYP2D6, increasing venlafaxine levels.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and CNS effects closely; dose adjustment may be necessary; use with caution in patients with cardiovascular disease or hypertension.
